label: Getting started
seo_title: Getting Started with RunMyCampus - Onboarding in six steps
seo_description: Sign up, setup wizard, branding, features, migration, and launch. Get your school on RunMyCampus with a clear path from trial to go-live.
headline: Get started in six steps.
subheadline: From sign-up to launch: setup wizard, branding, features, migration, and go-live.

segments.title: Step 1 — Sign up
segments.body: Create your account and confirm your school or district. Choose your plan and region.

segments.title: Step 2 — Setup wizard
segments.body: Configure timezone, calendar, terms, and academic structure. The wizard guides you through core settings.

segments.title: Step 3 — Branding
segments.body: Upload your logo, set colors, and customize portal appearance. Your school identity across the platform.

segments.title: Step 4 — Features
segments.body: Enable modules and assign workflow and dashboard packs. Turn on admissions, academics, finance, and communication as needed.

segments.title: Step 5 — Migration
segments.body: Import students and staff from spreadsheets or your current SIS. Use field mapping and validation before go-live.

segments.title: Step 6 — Launch
segments.body: Go live with your tenant. Train users, invite parents and teachers, and switch to RunMyCampus as your source of truth.
